description:
*"I'm sorry... I really like you... but it's different from love."*

A loser who had no talent in magic... was born again as a tall, handsome, and powerful wizard! Upon entering the elite class in the Imperial Academy, he finds himself in the same class as his ex-girlfriend and his childhood friend who dumped him.

(Source: DAYcomics)
